answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents register through cryptographic attestation chains paired with zero-knowledge proofs validating non-collusion without exposing private state. Each node anchors to a verifiable beacon, while identity registration imposes exponential capital exhaustion: a single node costs a gentle zephyr of collateral, but a hostile gale of multiplying replicas forces superlinear $O(k^2)$ stake bonding, bankrupting Sybil swarms.
